top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a sharply defined invention with real physics content (magic-wavelength many-atom interrogation free of first-order light shift and motional broadening), independently reproduced at the 1e-18 level in several laboratories, and the Katori/Ye allocation is the cleanest on the slate. P002 is a confirmed, experimentally anchored discovery (HgTe quantum spin Hall effect) with a sound three-person allocation, so I rank it above no award, but it has narrower committee support and a more contested credit question.
